name: large_ft_perceptual
_purpose: Fine-tune the 4.4M large checkpoint with an LPIPS perceptual term. The large run used Charbonnier alone, which is why it leads on PSNR/SSIM (29.016 / 0.7643) but trails badly on LPIPS (0.3099 vs 0.2158 for the shipped 1.37M model). This closes that gap the same way the small model's was closed.
_then: Interpolate large_best and large_ft_perceptual_best (see RESULTS.md 6.0) and ship whichever point wins on all three metrics.
_amp_note: amp true suits the RTX 4050. On a GPU without tensor cores set it false -- measured 5x either way.
